scope: Piecewise-constant scheduler observations. State changes and50ms snapshots are not GPU activity. The analysis excludes drain from the primary queue interval. Growth uses101 held-state samples on its central10–90%. No-growth in a finite trace is not proof of sustainable capacity. D decode-ready waiting excludes active decoders and remote-KV waiting. An empty queue does not establish a safe window. Replica queues in Agg are colocated prefill/decode states,not P/D-role queues.
